name: CareStream HIS
tagline: Hospital information system for a 400-bed multi-speciality hospital
summary: CareStream runs a 400-bed hospital: ICU vitals streaming, an HL7 interface engine, electronic medical records, lab results, pharmacy, OPD appointments, insurance billing and patient alerts. A lossy HL7 queue, exact-match patient identity and a synchronous notification sender keep hurting patients and staff.

tour.headline: An in-memory HL7 queue has dropped ICU vitals and lab results three times; a durable queue costs 28 hours.

incidents.title: ICU vitals delayed by 12 minutes on the nurse dashboard
incidents.desc: Bedside monitor readings for ICU-2 reached the central nurse dashboard 8 to 12 minutes late during the morning ward round; one desaturation alarm was noticed late.
whys: ICU vitals reached the nurse dashboard late
HL7 messages from bedside monitors were queued and dropped
The HL7 listener queue overflowed during the ward-round burst
HL7 listener uses an in-memory queue that drops messages when full
incidents.fix: Restarted the HL7 listener and increased the queue size to 5,000.
incidents.lesson: A bigger queue only delays the overflow.

incidents.title: Same patient registered twice with different MRNs
incidents.desc: A returning patient was registered again at the OPD counter because her name was typed 'Laxmi Devi' instead of 'Lakshmi Devi'; her earlier records were not visible to the doctor.
whys: The patient's previous records were not visible
A second medical record number was created
Patient matching uses exact name and date-of-birth comparison

incidents.title: OPD appointment reminders not sent on Monday
incidents.desc: No SMS reminders went out for 380 Monday appointments; the SMS provider returned errors and the job gave up.
whys: Patients did not receive appointment reminders
SMS provider calls failed and were not retried
Notification service sends synchronously with no retry queue
incidents.lesson: Failures are only logged; nobody retries.

incidents.title: Dispensing blocked: stock shows zero while shelves are full
incidents.desc: The pharmacy could not dispense pantoprazole because the system showed zero stock; 600 strips were physically available.
whys: Medicine could not be dispensed
System stock count was lower than physical stock
Returned medicines are not posted back to the stock ledger
incidents.fix: Corrected stock by a manual adjustment.
incidents.lesson: Manual adjustments hide the missing return posting.

incidents.title: Insurance claims rejected for missing ICD-10 codes
incidents.desc: The TPA rejected 47 cashless claims in one week because the diagnosis code field was empty; finance re-submitted them manually.
whys: Cashless claims were rejected
Claims were sent without diagnosis codes
Billing reads diagnosis codes from free-text doctor notes
incidents.fix: Finance team added codes by hand and resubmitted.
incidents.lesson: Billing depends on how doctors type notes.

incidents.title: Two patients booked into the same OPD slot
incidents.desc: Cardiology OPD had two patients confirmed for the 10:30 slot; both booked online within the same second.
whys: Two patients got the same appointment slot
Concurrent bookings both saw the slot as free
Slot reservation reads and writes without a row lock

incidents.title: Discharge summary PDF missing the medication list
incidents.desc: Discharge summaries printed after 6 PM omitted medicines prescribed that afternoon; patients left without complete instructions.
whys: The discharge summary was incomplete
The PDF template skipped medications added after 6 PM
The template reads from a cached copy of the medication order
incidents.lesson: Clinical documents must read live data.

incidents.title: ADT feed rejected after interface engine upgrade
incidents.desc: Admission-discharge-transfer messages failed validation after the HL7 library upgrade changed how PV1 segments are parsed; bed occupancy went stale for a day.
whys: ADT messages were rejected
The new HL7 library parsed PV1 segments differently
HL7 interfaces have no contract tests
incidents.lesson: We could not tell what the upgrade would break.

incidents.title: Lab results missing from the EMR for three hours
incidents.desc: Completed CBC and electrolyte results from the lab system did not appear in patient charts until the afternoon; doctors phoned the lab for values.
whys: Lab results did not reach patient charts
ORU result messages were lost between the lab system and EMR
HL7 listener uses an in-memory queue that drops messages when full
incidents.fix: Re-sent the day's results from the lab system.
incidents.lesson: Same lossy queue as the ICU delay.

incidents.title: Allergy banner not shown on paediatric charts
incidents.desc: Paediatric patient charts did not display the red allergy banner; a nurse caught a penicillin allergy only from the paper file.
whys: The allergy banner was missing
The paediatric chart layout omits the banner component
Chart layouts are copied instead of shared
incidents.fix: Added the banner to the paediatric layout.

incidents.title: Radiology report attached to the wrong duplicate patient record
incidents.desc: Two records existed for one patient; the CT report went to the older record and the treating doctor could not find it for a day.
whys: The report was filed under a duplicate record
The patient had two medical record numbers
Patient matching uses exact name and date-of-birth comparison
incidents.fix: Merged the records and re-linked the report.
incidents.lesson: Duplicate records now affect clinical decisions.

incidents.title: Critical potassium alert SMS reached the doctor 40 minutes late
incidents.desc: A critical lab value alert waited behind bulk reminder messages because alerts and reminders share one synchronous sender.
whys: The critical value alert was delayed
Alerts waited behind bulk reminder messages
Alerts and reminders share one sender with no priority
Notification service sends synchronously with no retry queue
incidents.fix: Paused bulk reminders during lab hours.
incidents.lesson: Patient-safety alerts need their own priority.

incidents.title: EMR slow during morning rounds
incidents.desc: Opening patient charts took 15 to 20 seconds between 8 and 10 AM; database CPU stayed at 100%.
whys: Patient charts opened slowly
Database CPU was saturated
The chart query loads all historical vitals
Vitals history is not paginated or archived
incidents.fix: Added a read replica for chart queries.
incidents.lesson: The query still reads years of vitals.

incidents.title: Inventory count drifts after ward returns
incidents.desc: The weekly stock audit found 3% drift on high-use drugs; ward returns were written in a register but never entered in the system.
whys: The stock audit showed drift
Ward returns were not recorded in the system
Returned medicines are not posted back to the stock ledger
incidents.fix: Posted the month's returns in bulk.

incidents.title: ABHA health ID verification failing for new registrations
incidents.desc: New registrations could not verify ABHA IDs for six hours after the government API rotated its TLS certificate.
whys: ABHA verification failed
The government API rotated its certificate
The certificate was pinned in code with no rotation process
incidents.lesson: Pinned certificates need a rotation runbook.

incidents.title: TPA rejecting claims with an empty diagnosis code field
incidents.desc: Claim rejections are back after the EMR note template changed; billing could not extract ICD-10 codes from the new note format.
whys: Cashless claims were rejected
Claims were sent without diagnosis codes
Billing reads diagnosis codes from free-text doctor notes

incidents.title: Wrong temperature unit shown from new bedside monitors
incidents.desc: New monitors send Fahrenheit; the dashboard displayed 98.6 degrees Celsius and triggered a fever alert.
whys: Temperature was displayed with the wrong unit
The unit field from the new monitor model was ignored
Unit conversion assumes one monitor vendor
incidents.fix: Added a conversion for the new model.
incidents.lesson: Every new vendor will need another special case.

incidents.title: Vitals stream dropped again during ICU shift change
incidents.desc: Monitor data for 14 ICU beds stopped updating for 9 minutes at the 8 AM shift change; the HL7 listener logged 'queue full, discarding message'.
whys: ICU vitals stopped updating on the dashboard
HL7 messages from bedside monitors were queued and dropped
HL7 listener uses an in-memory queue that drops messages when full

incidents.title: Doctor's calendar shows overlapping appointments
incidents.desc: The orthopaedics calendar shows overlapping bookings since the mobile app launch increased concurrent bookings.
whys: The calendar showed overlapping appointments
Concurrent bookings both saw the slot as free
Slot reservation reads and writes without a row lock

incidents.title: Appointment reminder SMS failed after provider timeout
incidents.desc: Reminders for 210 appointments were not delivered when the SMS gateway timed out for 15 minutes; failures were only logged.
whys: Patients did not receive appointment reminders
SMS provider calls failed and were not retried
Notification service sends synchronously with no retry queue

incidents.title: Expired drug batch shown as available for dispensing
incidents.desc: A batch of insulin that expired last week was still offered at the dispensing counter.
whys: An expired batch could be dispensed
The expiry check runs only when stock is received
No scheduled job re-validates batch expiry

incidents.title: Duplicate MRNs created for walk-in patients written with initials
incidents.desc: Registration staff entering 'K. Ramesh' and 'Ramesh K' created separate MRNs for the same patient twice this week.
whys: Duplicate medical record numbers were created
Name variations were treated as different people
Patient matching uses exact name and date-of-birth comparison

incidents.title: Room rent charged for an extra day after midnight discharge
incidents.desc: Patients discharged between 00:00 and 01:00 were billed room rent for an additional day.
whys: Patients were billed an extra day
Day count uses calendar dates
Billing rules are not unit-tested for midnight boundaries

incidents.title: Radiology orders duplicated in PACS
incidents.desc: CT orders appeared twice in the imaging system; radiographers nearly scanned a patient twice.
whys: Radiology orders appeared twice in PACS
HL7 ORM messages were re-sent after an acknowledgement timeout
HL7 interfaces have no contract tests

debts.title: Replace the in-memory HL7 queue with a durable message queue
debts.desc: Persist inbound HL7 messages before acknowledging them; apply back-pressure instead of dropping.
debts.cause: HL7 listener uses an in-memory queue that drops messages when full

debts.title: Contract tests for HL7 ADT, ORU and ORM interfaces
debts.desc: Golden-message tests run on every interface change and library upgrade.
debts.cause: HL7 interfaces have no contract tests

debts.title: HL7 message replay tool
debts.desc: Replay persisted messages for a time window after an outage.

debts.title: Probabilistic patient matching (phonetic name, DOB, phone)
debts.desc: Score candidate matches and ask staff to confirm likely duplicates at registration.
debts.cause: Patient matching uses exact name and date-of-birth comparison

debts.title: Audit trail for patient record merges
debts.desc: Record who merged which records and allow unmerge.

debts.title: Asynchronous notification queue with retries and priorities
debts.desc: Queue every message, retry with backoff, and send critical clinical alerts ahead of bulk reminders.
debts.cause: Notification service sends synchronously with no retry queue

debts.title: Post ward returns to the stock ledger
debts.desc: Returns entered at the ward update stock immediately.
debts.cause: Returned medicines are not posted back to the stock ledger

debts.title: Structured ICD-10 diagnosis capture in the EMR
debts.desc: Doctors pick coded diagnoses; notes stay free text.
debts.cause: Billing reads diagnosis codes from free-text doctor notes

debts.title: Auto-code claims from structured diagnoses
debts.desc: Fill claim diagnosis codes from the EMR and the de-duplicated patient record.

debts.title: Row-level lock on OPD slot reservation
debts.desc: Reserve slots with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE inside a transaction.
debts.cause: Slot reservation reads and writes without a row lock

debts.title: Paginate and archive vitals history
debts.desc: Charts load the last 72 hours; older vitals move to an archive table.
debts.cause: Vitals history is not paginated or archived

debts.title: Certificate rotation runbook for the ABHA integration
debts.desc: Load the certificate from configuration and alert 30 days before expiry.
debts.cause: The certificate was pinned in code with no rotation process

debts.title: Vendor-neutral unit conversion for monitor data
debts.desc: Read UCUM units from every observation instead of assuming Celsius.
debts.cause: Unit conversion assumes one monitor vendor

debts.title: Nightly batch-expiry validation job
debts.desc: Block expired batches every night, not only at receipt.
debts.cause: No scheduled job re-validates batch expiry

debts.title: Unit tests for billing day-boundary rules
debts.desc: Tests for midnight admissions and discharges.
debts.cause: Billing rules are not unit-tested for midnight boundaries
